development.description: Construction of six wind turbines with associated infrastructure including access tracks, electrical cabling, hard standing areas, drainage features and a temporary construction compound.

lpa_summary.overall_summary: The proposal seeks permission for six commercial-scale wind turbines and supporting infrastructure on agricultural land south-east of Bridlington.
key_facts: Maximum turbine blade tip height of 180m.
Agricultural land currently used for arable farming.
A drainage strategy proposes controlled discharge to local watercourses.

relevant_documents.summary: The planning statement confirms the proposal comprises six commercial-scale wind turbines and supporting infrastructure. The site is located on agricultural land south-east of Bridlington. Turbines will have a maximum tip height of 180m. New access tracks and a temporary construction compound are proposed.
Provides the red-line site boundary and confirms the development location at latitude 53.886192 and longitude -0.149756. Total development area approximately 18.2 hectares.
Surface water generated by the development will be managed using attenuation features before controlled discharge to nearby watercourses. Estimated discharge exceeds 5m3/day.
Assesses visual, ecological, landscape and hydrological effects associated with construction and operation of six wind turbines.
